records.label: Stores energy
records.meaning: Energy resides in the selected system/state and can later participate in interactions

records.label: Carries energy
records.meaning: A propagating excitation transports energy across space or a boundary
records.does_not_mean: The carrier is the only possible energy form
records.example: EM wave; acoustic wave; gravitational wave

records.label: Receives / gains energy
records.meaning: Selected subsystem gains energy from another system

records.label: Transfers energy
records.meaning: Energy crosses a stated system boundary
records.example: heat conduction; radiation crossing a surface

records.label: Converts energy
records.meaning: Energy changes form or degree of freedom

records.label: Absorbs energy
records.meaning: Incoming energy is taken up by the selected system
records.does_not_mean: All absorbed energy remains permanently stored

records.label: Emits / radiates energy
records.meaning: Energy leaves in propagating excitations or radiation

records.label: Does work / drives
records.meaning: Energy transfer produces controlled change in another subsystem
records.does_not_mean: The driver must have the same frequency as the target

records.label: Dissipates energy
records.meaning: Organized energy becomes distributed into less recoverable microscopic forms

records.label: Thermalizes
records.meaning: Energy redistributes among microscopic populations toward equilibrium
records.does_not_mean: Energy is lost from the total accounting

records.label: Disperses energy
records.meaning: Energy spreads in space direction modes or spectrum
records.example: wave spreading; radiation into many directions

records.label: Maintains steady state
records.meaning: Stored energy remains approximately constant through balanced inputs/outputs

records.label: Exchanges energy
records.meaning: Energy can flow in either direction depending on state/conditions

records.label: Mediates / enables
records.meaning: System enables an energy-transfer pathway without being primary source

records.label: Reads out / modulates
records.meaning: System carries information about another variable; detector power may come from elsewhere

records.label: Unknown energy role
records.meaning: No established energy-transfer mechanism is known
records.does_not_mean: A new energy form has been detected

rules.label: No create-from-nothing label
rules.meaning: Project rule: apparent energy production must be traced to storage conversion mass-energy or external input
